```sql
select sum(arr_delay_sum) / sum(flown) as value from turnaround.mart_carrier_month where carrier = 'B6' and year = 2016
```

```sql
select cbsa_title as label, max(median_income) as value from doorstep.mart_metro_year where (kind = 'metropolitan') and cbsa_title in ('Los Angeles-Long Beach-Anaheim, CA', 'Dallas-Fort Worth-Arlington, TX') and year = 2013 group by cbsa_title order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select cbsa_title as label, min(price_to_income) as value from doorstep.mart_metro_year where (kind = 'metropolitan') and cbsa_title in ('Cincinnati, OH-KY-IN', 'Baltimore-Columbia-Towson, MD') and year = 2015 group by cbsa_title order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select year as label, max(payment_share) as value from doorstep.ch1_national_series where year in (2010, 2023) group by year order by label
```

```sql
select cbsa_title as label, max(permits) as value from doorstep.mart_metro_year where (kind = 'metropolitan') and cbsa_title in ('Kansas City, MO-KS', 'Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN') and year = 2009 group by cbsa_title order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select max(payment_share) as value from doorstep.mart_metro_year where (kind = 'metropolitan') and cbsa_title = 'Las Vegas-Henderson-North Las Vegas, NV' and year = 2013
```

```sql
select max(value_anchored) as value from doorstep.mart_metro_year where (kind = 'metropolitan') and cbsa_title = 'Kansas City, MO-KS' and year = 2024
```

```sql

```
